name: feature-filter-grid
title: Feature filter grid
description: A grid of many features with chips to filter by area or role, announcing how many are shown and holding its height so nothing jumps.
docs: Pass features (an id, an icon, a title, a line, the ids of the groups it belongs to, and optionally an href and a tag) and groups (an id and a label for each chip after All). A chip is only offered when at least one feature belongs to it, and each shows how many features it holds. The chips are a toggle group: arrow keys move between them, Space or Enter chooses, Tab leaves, and choosing the chosen chip again changes nothing. Choosing a chip narrows the grid in place and says, politely, "Showing 7 of 24 features"; the grid keeps the height it had while the new cells arrive and then settles to its own, so the page below does not jump. Under reduced motion it changes at once. A feature can sit in several groups, and one with none shows only under All. With an href the whole cell is a link named by its title; its arrow shows on hover and focus, and always on a touch screen. The cells come in one, two or three columns by the width of the block, not of the screen. Use defaultGroup to start on a chip, or group and onGroupChange to control it ("all" is the id of the first chip), label to name the chips for assistive technology, headingLevel for the heading, and labels to translate the fixed words.
